attributes.action: To open more mental health centres to implement better support and care .
attributes.additional_details: Losing my son jason to suicide in may 2025 was the most devastating thing to happen to our family especially when he was in the care of the mental health trust because has a family we were not listened too.  Like so many families and all those affected by mental health we need to see changes in our mental health services because far too many are losing their loved ones too soon when alot of these deaths could of been avoided if more support and care was available because their mental health matters.
attributes.background: We need more walk in centres specialising in mental health support and care which provide 24/7 availability for families and all those affected by mental health. So that families can get the support straight away not stood on a phone or put on waiting lists because all this waiting is costing lives

rejection.details: Please see this press release from the Government: https://www.gov.uk/government/news/major-expansion-of-community-mental-health-support-across-england
